findings.name: semantic q visibility delay

findings.name: frontier-qualified nonterminal mover cofactor
findings.statement: After native frontier exact cases are excluded, no playable mover singleton exists; WSL terminal reduction occurs only by consuming singleton {cell}; therefore a legal worker mover cofactor on that edge cannot return RESIDUAL_TERMINAL_WIN.

findings.name: executor pre-dispatch structuredClone excess
findings.statement: Current fresh IsoMax task messages are explicitly structuredClone'd by the shared executor before another object is constructed for Worker.postMessage, but shared ownership and prior manager economics do not justify change without direct transport evidence.

findings.name: per-task full memory census on result critical path
findings.statement: Every successful worker result calls full process.memoryUsage() before postMessage; worker executionMs excludes this cost.

findings.name: native forced-cell provenance fast path
findings.statement: Native forced cells originate from the maintained playable mask and can retain that provenance so proof-facing forced-cell validation remains exclusive to external/certificate consequences.

findings.name: manager child q derivation from live parent state
findings.statement: Manager replay(parentMoves+column) is exactly reconstructible as replay(parentMoves); applyUnchecked(column). Child q can be derived from the already-live parent state while move history remains the worker portability format.

findings.name: semantic outdegree-one decision-frontier collapse
findings.statement: Deterministic macro-edge structure is ordinary legal-action outdegree one, not specifically threat-forced classification.
